# Moving Average Exponential

*Exponentially weighted mean, reacts faster than SMA.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Moving Average Exponential** under **Moving averages**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `9` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/ema.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Moving Average Exponential", shortTitle: "EMA", overlay: true });
const length = input.int("Length", 9, { min: 1 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
plot(ta.ema(src, length), { title: "EMA", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
